answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity earn its way through witnessed labor. Each newcomer stakes collateral, performs randomized work, and seeks signatures from reviewers outside its cluster. A tide of reputation rises only after repeated independent agreement, a terrace ledger stacks every verified result, and a quartz proof binds each claim to a signed record. Audits slash fabricated histories, so mass registration yields cost and scrutiny instead of influence.
